lines.zh: 我一步踩下，树根都翻起来。
lines.en: One step of mine turns the roots up.
The timber in my trunk creaks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢穿过林子，枝条让开。
lines.en: I pass through the wood and branches give way.

lines.zh: 手臂擦过树干，树皮掉了。
lines.en: My arm brushes a trunk and the bark peels.

lines.zh: 我每一步都让地面沉一点。
lines.en: Every step sinks the ground a little.

lines.zh: 我身上缠着藤，走一路拖一路。
lines.en: Vines cling to me and drag along.
I shift toward the clearing.
I stop, then take another step.

lines.zh: 我举起手，挡开一根横枝。
lines.en: I raise a hand to push a branch aside.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方剩下一道沟。
lines.en: A furrow marks where I've walked.
I stand still while vines move in the wind.

lines.zh: 我的躯干里传出木头的响声。
lines.en: Wood creaks inside my trunk.
A bird lands on my shoulder.
I turn my head and moss sifts off.
My eyes are two points of green light.
Insects crawl at my feet.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸像风吹过林子。
lines.en: My breathing is wind in the trees.
I raise an arm and lower it.
I'm growing — very slowly.
Soil falls from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾已经长进土里了。
lines.en: My toes have grown into the soil.
Sunlight comes through my fingers.
I count the tree shadows.
I stay silent a long while.
A patch of moss grows on my hide.
My breath moves like wind in the wood.

lines.zh: 你踏进来的脚印我数得清
lines.en: I can count every print you leave coming in.
I lower my head to see you — a long way down.
Every tree here is mine.

lines.zh: 两点绿光在我脸上转亮
lines.en: Two green lights brighten on my face.

lines.zh: 斧刃上的树脂，我闻得出。
lines.en: I can smell the resin on your axe blade.
I raise a hand, then stop.

lines.zh: 你退开，我便不再往前压
lines.en: You step back, so I press no further.
I've stood here a very long time.
The trees speak for you.
You're standing on my roots.
I lower my head all the way.
I blink slowly, like wind.
I give a crack, like splitting timber.
A pale split opens across my chest.
I give half a step and the ground sinks.
Bark peels off me.
I tip my head over by degrees.

lines.zh: 我的绿光抖了抖，暗下去
lines.en: My green light wavers and dims.
Soil spills from the wound.
I don't cry out; I just straighten.
I can still swing my arm.

lines.zh: 你的味道留在我的树皮上。
lines.en: Your scent is on my bark.
Something's buried in the soil.
I feel the roots move.
Are those seeds in your hand?
I'll bury it.
I hold out my palm and wait.

lines.zh: 我用掌心把它压进湿土
lines.en: I press it into the damp soil with my palm.
Give me more.

lines.zh: 我把它埋在须根最密处
lines.en: I bury it where the roots are thickest.
My fingers are clumsy.

lines.zh: 我俯身凑近你手里的东西
lines.en: I stoop toward what you are holding.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，退了很远。
lines.en: You hit me and go back a long way.
Not a flake of bark moved.

lines.zh: 这一撞震掉了我肩上的土。
lines.en: That knocked the soil off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你脚下断了一根我的须根
lines.en: One of my hair roots snaps under your foot.
I've moved my foot.
I move my shoulder aside to clear a path.
The brush rattles where I hit it.
You're very small in my shadow.
I wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 我把树根从你脚边挪开
lines.en: I shift my roots away from your feet.
There's only me in this wood.
I've kept these trees a long time.

lines.zh: 我听见根在土里互相碰。
lines.en: I hear roots touching under the soil.
One tree stands very close to me.

lines.zh: 我把手放在它的树干上。
lines.en: I lay my hand on its trunk.
It grows faster than I do.
I move aside to give it the light.
The tree and I need no words.
The wind comes and we sway together.
I'll keep watch until it's taller than me.
I pick up a broken branch.
I set it upright back where it was.
I've moved this stone.

lines.zh: 我的手指捏碎了一颗种子。
lines.en: My fingers crushed a seed.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进空心的树干
lines.en: I tuck it into a hollow trunk.
I pick it up and look a long while.
It's so small in my hand.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指刨坑埋了它
lines.en: I scoop a pit with two fingers and bury it.
I hold it like a bird.
I set it down to grow on its own.
Someone's cutting trees.
I hear an axe.
All my roots have gone taut.
I lift my face out of the canopy.
There are still many trees in this wood.
I've fixed on that figure.
I walk that way, slowly.
The ground is shaking.
The trees make way.

lines.zh: 我不吼，根已经把路封死
lines.en: I do not roar; my roots have sealed the way.
I raise my hand to chest height.
It is still cutting away.
I'm ten paces from it.
It heard my footsteps.

lines.zh: 它把斧头转过来对着我
lines.en: It swings its axe round to face me.
Since you won't back off, I move first.
I lean my weight toward it.

lines.zh: 树根在我脚下断了几根。
lines.en: Roots snap under my feet.
I've blocked its way out.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先罩住它
lines.en: My shadow covers it before I do.
Each step of mine crushes a layer of leaves.
It runs left; I swing across.

lines.zh: 我的手臂扫开一丛灌木。
lines.en: My arm sweeps a thicket aside.

lines.zh: 它砍了我一下，我像没感觉。
lines.en: It struck me and I barely felt it.
I pull my roots up out of the soil.
It's backed under a tree.
That tree is mine.

lines.zh: 我的手掌摊开，像一片树阴
lines.en: My open palm spreads like a patch of shade.
It's running around the trees.

lines.zh: 树挡住了它，不是挡住我。
lines.en: The trees block it, not me.

lines.zh: 我眼里的绿光烧得更旺
lines.en: The green in my eyes burns brighter.
I'm very close now.
It's stopped cutting.
It's raised the axe.
I wait for it to swing.
I won't give up this wood.
Soil falls from my shoulders.
I close the way off, section by section.
It has nowhere left to go.

lines.zh: 我把腰弯到与树干齐平
lines.en: I bend until my waist is level with the trunk.

lines.zh: 我一拳砸下去，地面裂开。
lines.en: My fist comes down and the ground splits.
My arm sweeps and trees fall.
I hold it flat against the soil.
That snapped the roots.

lines.zh: 我一掌推出去，它飞了很远。
lines.en: My palm shoves and it flies far.

lines.zh: 它砍在我肩上，木头裂了一点。
lines.en: It struck my shoulder; the wood split a little.
I catch its arm.
I close my fingers slowly.
I strike again.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了整棵树的力。
lines.en: That one used the strength of a whole tree.
It's down in the leaf litter.
A shower of leaves comes down.
I raise my hand and pause.
I throw it clear.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，树都摇。
lines.en: I rise out of the soil and the trees shake.
Roots come up with me.
The first thing I see is green.
I stand taller than the treetops.
Vines hang from my shoulders.
I open my fingers out of the soil.
Birds circle me.
Wind pushes out from my timber.
The soil sinks under my feet.
I call out, like distant thunder.
The trees lean toward me.

lines.zh: 我低头，看见很小的东西。
lines.en: I look down and see something very small.
I sink my roots into the soil.
Every sound around stops.
This wood knows me.
I lift a foot and the leaves part first.
I come down and the grove sways with me.
There's a place where something was cut.
I head for it.
I slowly close my fist.

lines.zh: 火顺着我的木头往上爬。
lines.en: Fire climbs the timber of me.

lines.zh: 我砸到地上，半边身子散了。
lines.en: I hit the ground and half of me comes apart.

lines.zh: 水渗进我的木头，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water soaks into my wood and I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把我身上的树皮掀掉一层。
lines.en: The blast strips a layer of bark off me.

lines.zh: 一支火箭钉进了我的胸口。
lines.en: A fire arrow sticks in my chest.
A spell has bound my roots.
No nourishment in the soil; I'm withering.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，木头一片焦黑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my timber blackens.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我整棵坠下去。
lines.en: The ground is gone and I fall whole.
